screens.name: Plan editor dialog (خطة جديدة / تعديل الخطة)
Level editor dialog (مسار جديد / تعديل مستوى)
Save plan changes dialog (حفظ تعديلات الخطة)

epics.name: Annual Plan Portfolio & Lifecycle
epics.description: Register of annual plans, creation, approval/active flags and budget locking.

epics.name: Plan Structure Management
epics.description: Hierarchical levels (tracks, items, initiatives) edited in an evidenced edit session, with audit history and leaf indicators.

epics.name: Budget Monitoring & Visualization
epics.description: Single budget-math engine (used, available, pending, approved, due, paid) and the summary, hierarchy and tree views built on it.

epics.name: Budget Adjustments
epics.description: Evidenced increase, decrease and transfer of level budgets with propagation up the hierarchy, and the operations register.

epics.name: Endowments
epics.description: Endowment funding ledger, participation and percentage splits across plan levels, and the endowment portion report.

epics.name: Plan Linkage & Initiatives
epics.description: Linking applications, projects and programs to plan items, lock enforcement, and initiatives modelled as projects.

features.name: Annual plans register
features.description: Tabular list of annual plans with spend and indicator progress, status/approval/year/date filters, saved view, export, row navigation and per-plan action menu.
acceptance_criteria: All plans are listed with name, year, budget, spend %, indicator %, status and approval.
Filters for status, approval and year persist per user when the view is saved.
Portfolio KPIs are computed on approved plans only, sum-based.

features.name: Create annual plan
features.description: Dialog to create a plan with name, year, budget, active and approved flags, optionally pre-filled by AI assist.
acceptance_criteria: A plan can be created with name, year and budget ≥ 0.
New plans default to next year, active and not approved.
A reference number PLN-… is assigned.

features.name: Plan budget lock and reopen
features.description: Lock a plan so no new projects can be approved from its budget, recording the treatment of outstanding obligations and a decision document; reopen when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Locking requires both obligation choices and an evidence file.
A locked plan's items are not offered in pickers and project transfer is refused.
Reopening restores availability.

features.name: Hierarchy edit session
features.description: View-by-default hierarchy with an explicit edit mode (?edit=1) where users draft level additions, level edits and plan-header changes (including approval/active flags), preview their effect, and commit all at once with one evidence document.
acceptance_criteria: No change is written until «حفظ الكل».
Changes to existing items require one evidence document; additions only do not.
Each changed existing item produces one history row with before/after values.

features.name: Plan edit audit history
features.description: List of evidenced plan and level edits on summary, hierarchy and tree pages with access to the evidence document.
acceptance_criteria: History lists each edit with type, target, date and document.
Evidence opens through a time-limited signed URL.

features.name: Leaf-level plan indicators
features.description: Display and (in edit mode) add/delete quantitative or milestone indicators on leaf plan levels.
acceptance_criteria: Indicators appear only on persisted leaf levels.
A linked indicator cannot be deleted.

features.name: Budget breakdown engine
features.description: Shared calculation of used, actual available and the five-way split (paid, due, approved/committed, available, pending) per level and per plan, including multi-initiative splits, spend ratios and project progress.
acceptance_criteria: Figures follow BR-PLN-01…08 exactly (see worked examples §6.6).
Pending never reduces available.
A multi-initiative project is counted once in total.

features.name: Plan summary dashboard
features.description: One-page overview: total budget split, spend KPIs, per-track distribution with over-budget flag, linked initiatives and recent adjustments.
acceptance_criteria: Summary shows plan breakdown, three KPI bars, per-track bars, initiatives and last five adjustments.
Tracks with negative available are flagged.

features.name: Hierarchical plan view
features.description: Collapsible tree of tracks and nested levels with amount, money split, budget warnings, endowment chips, projects/applications drill-down and a view switcher.
acceptance_criteria: Every level shows its amount and breakdown.
Project and application counts include descendants and open a list dialog.

features.name: Plan tree diagram
features.description: Read-only organisation-chart style diagram of the plan with each level's amount and share of its parent.
acceptance_criteria: Each node shows code-name, share % and amount.
Mismatched children sums show a warning on the node.

features.name: Budget adjustment execution
features.description: Dialog to increase, decrease or transfer a level's budget with mandatory evidence; changes propagate to all ancestors and (for increase/decrease) to the plan budget, and are recorded.
acceptance_criteria: No adjustment executes without a valid evidence document.
Decrease/transfer cannot exceed the source's actual available.
Ancestors and plan budget are updated as per BR-PLN-13…15.

features.name: Financial operations register
features.description: List of executed adjustments by type and plan with reference, levels, amount, creator, note, evidence and date.
acceptance_criteria: Adjustments are filtered by type tab and plan.
Evidence opens via signed URL.

features.name: Endowment funding ledger
features.description: Record dated, evidenced funding movements for an endowment; endowment size is their sum.
acceptance_criteria: A funding needs amount > 0, date and evidence.
Endowment size equals the sum of fundings.

features.name: Endowment participation and splits
features.description: Determine which endowments fund each level and in what percentage (own, inherited or default equal split), and let users toggle an endowment's participation per level.
acceptance_criteria: With one active endowment every level is 100 % that endowment.
Toggling rewrites the level's split equally among participants; the last participant cannot leave.

features.name: Endowment portion report
features.description: Per endowment: its allocation, used and available across the organization's plans, level-by-level percentages and funded projects.
acceptance_criteria: Allocation, used and available follow BR-PLN-30/31.
Inherited percentages are labelled «(موروث)».

features.name: Plan item linking
features.description: Reusable pickers to link applications, projects and grant programs (default item) to plan items, and applicant-facing initiative selection, both limited to active unlocked plans; lock enforced at project transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Pickers list only non-root levels of active, unlocked plans.
Transfer to a project from a locked plan is refused.

features.name: Initiatives as projects
features.description: Initiatives are projects with source = initiative; legacy route redirects to the filtered projects list; initiative progress is derived from weighted activities and shown on the plan summary.
acceptance_criteria: /initiatives lands on /projects?source=initiative.
Initiative progress = weighted activity progress.

requirements.statement: The system shall list annual plans with name, year, budget, spend-from-budget %, indicator achievement %, active status and approval status, with plan number and creation date available as optional columns.
acceptance_criteria: Each plan appears once with the seven default columns.
Plan number and creation date are hidden by default and can be shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall filter plans by active status, approval status, year (2021–2031) and creation date range, and persist status/approval/year, hidden columns and page size in the user's saved view.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting «معتمد» shows only approved plans.
A saved view restores the status, approval and year filters on next visit.

requirements.statement: The system shall show portfolio KPI cards: number of plans, spend from budget across approved plans (sum-based), and budget-weighted indicator achievement across approved plans.
acceptance_criteria: Spend KPI = Σ paid ÷ Σ budget of approved plans.
Unapproved plans do not affect the spend and indicator KPIs.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow exporting the plans table and toggling column visibility, excluding the actions column from exports.
acceptance_criteria: Export file is named annual-plans.
Actions column is not exported.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide per-plan actions: view summary (row click, name, eye icon), lock/reopen, increase, decrease, transfer, and «تعديل الخطة والاعتماد» opening the edit session.
acceptance_criteria: Row click opens /plans/$id/summary.
The menu offers the three adjustment types and the edit session link.

requirements.statement: The system shall create a plan with name, year, budget, active and approved flags, assigning a PLN reference number.
acceptance_criteria: Saving a valid form inserts a plan and shows «تم حفظ الخطة».
The new plan appears in the list with a PLN-… number.

requirements.statement: The system shall validate that plan name and year are provided and budget is a finite number ≥ 0.
acceptance_criteria: Empty name shows «الاسم والسنة مطلوبان».
Invalid budget shows «أدخل موازنة صحيحة».

requirements.statement: The system shall offer an AI assist that proposes plan name, year and budget from free text, applied to the form only on user action.
acceptance_criteria: AI proposals populate the form fields without saving.
User can edit proposed values before saving.

requirements.statement: The system shall lock a plan only after the user chooses the treatment of contracted-not-due and due-not-paid obligations and attaches an evidence file, then set budget_locked = true.
acceptance_criteria: «إغلاق الخطة» stays disabled until both choices and a file are set.
After confirmation the lock icon turns red and the plan is locked.

requirements.statement: The system shall reopen a locked plan after confirmation, setting budget_locked = false.
acceptance_criteria: Confirming «إعادة الفتح» unlocks the plan and shows «أُعيد فتح الخطة».
Cancelling leaves the plan locked.

requirements.statement: The system shall indicate each plan's lock state in the register with distinct icons and tooltips.
acceptance_criteria: Locked plans show a red closed-lock icon titled «الخطة مقفلة — اضغط لإعادة فتحها».
Unlocked plans show an open-lock icon titled «إغلاق الخطة».

requirements.statement: The system shall store each lock/reopen decision with actor, timestamp, obligation treatment choices and the uploaded evidence document.
acceptance_criteria: The evidence file is uploaded to private storage and retrievable.
Lock history shows choices and document.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide an explicit edit mode for a plan's hierarchy (search param edit=1) entered from the plan views or the register, and exited by cancel (discarding drafts) or successful save.
acceptance_criteria: Opening /plans/$id?edit=1 shows the amber session banner and edit controls.
«إلغاء» clears the draft and returns to view mode.

requirements.statement: The system shall let users add a root track or a child level to any level as a draft with name and amount, generating code and sort order automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Adding under level 1.2 with siblings 1.2.1–1.2.3 creates code 1.2.4.
The draft level appears highlighted before saving.

requirements.statement: The system shall let users edit a level's name and amount as a draft, keeping one pending change per level and dropping it when values return to the original.
acceptance_criteria: Editing the same level twice yields one change entry.
Restoring original values removes the change.

requirements.statement: The system shall let users edit plan name, year, budget, active and approved flags as a single draft change within the session.
acceptance_criteria: Applying the plan editor adds «تعديل بيانات الخطة» to the change list.
Only the last plan-header change is kept.

requirements.statement: The system shall recompute all displayed amounts, breakdowns and warnings with drafts applied and highlight changed items and the number of unsaved changes.
acceptance_criteria: After a draft amount change, the level's figures reflect the new amount.
Changed levels have an amber border/background.

requirements.statement: The system shall warn, without blocking, when the sum of a node's children differs from its amount, showing the children sum and the absolute difference.
acceptance_criteria: Parent 1,000,000 with children 600,000 + 300,000 shows difference 100,000.
Equal sums show no warning.

requirements.statement: The system shall present a save dialog listing all pending changes and require one evidence document when any existing item changes, otherwise stating that no document is needed.
acceptance_criteria: With a level edit pending, «حفظ الكل» is disabled until a file is chosen.
With additions only, the note «إضافات فقط — لا يلزم مستند نظامي.» is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall persist a session by uploading the evidence, inserting new levels parent-first (mapping temporary ids), updating edited plan/level rows and endowment splits, and writing one plan_edit_history row per changed existing item.
acceptance_criteria: A child added under a draft parent is saved with the parent's real id.
Each edited level produces a history row with before/after values and the evidence path.

requirements.statement: The system shall reject a session whose endowment splits (edited or for added levels) do not total 100 %.
acceptance_criteria: A split of 60 % + 30 % blocks saving with «مجموع نسب الأوقاف لكل مستوى يجب أن يساوي 100%».
An empty split (inherit) is accepted.

requirements.statement: The system shall commit an edit session atomically (all changes or none) and remove the evidence on failure.
acceptance_criteria: A failure in any change leaves the plan unchanged.
No orphan evidence file remains after a failed save.

requirements.statement: The system shall display the plan's edit history (plan vs level edit, target name, date, evidence name) on summary, hierarchy and tree pages, newest first.
acceptance_criteria: Each history row shows «تعديل مستوى» or «تعديل الخطة» with the target name.
Empty history shows «لا توجد تعديلات موثقة بعد.».

requirements.statement: The system shall open evidence documents through a signed URL valid for 300 seconds in a new tab.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the document opens it in a new tab.
If signing fails «تعذر فتح المستند النظامي» is shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall display indicators on persisted leaf levels of the hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: A leaf with indicators lists them.
Non-leaf levels and draft levels show no indicator block.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow adding (quantitative or milestone) and deleting leaf indicators in edit mode, preventing deletion of indicators linked to applications or projects.
acceptance_criteria: Quantitative indicator without unit or target is rejected.
Deleting a linked indicator shows the link counts and is not executed.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute, for every level, used and actual available amounts rolled up over the level and its descendants.
acceptance_criteria: Used includes descendant projects and approved untransferred applications.
Available = amount − used.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute the five-way split (paid, due, approved, available, pending) per level and per plan from projects, applications and payments.
acceptance_criteria: Worked example A (§6.6) yields paid 100,000, due 50,000, approved 600,000, available 250,000.
Pending is excluded from available.

requirements.statement: The system shall split a project funded by two or more plan allocations into one piece per allocation, prorating its payments by share.
acceptance_criteria: Worked example B: 90,000 paid splits into 60,000 and 30,000.
A project with one allocation counts fully at its plan_level_id.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute spend from budget and spend of approved per plan using a single definition reused across screens.
acceptance_criteria: Spend from budget is capped at 100 %.
A plan with budget 0 shows 0 %.

requirements.statement: The system shall render money splits as a stacked bar with paid, due, approved and available figures (full, compact or bare variants), pending shown aside, and negative available highlighted in red.
acceptance_criteria: Bar widths are proportional to max(total, paid+due+approved).
Negative available displays in destructive colour.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a per-project breakdown (contract value, approved-not-due, due, paid) for use on the project page.
acceptance_criteria: Approved = max(0, budget − paid − due).
Pending and available are 0 for a project.

requirements.statement: The system shall load plan data in one query set, failing on core tables but degrading secondary tables (history, endowments, shares, fundings, allocations) to empty with a warning.
acceptance_criteria: If plan_edit_history fails, plan pages still render.
If payments fail, the page shows the query error.

requirements.statement: The system shall show on the plan summary the plan year, approval and active status, total budget and the plan-level five-way breakdown.
acceptance_criteria: Header subtitle reads «{year} · معتمدة/غير معتمدة · فعالة/غير فعالة».
Unknown plan id shows «الخطة غير موجودة».

requirements.statement: The system shall show progress bars for spend from budget, spend of approved and indicator achievement.
acceptance_criteria: Values equal FR-PLN-030 results.
Indicator achievement shows the stored plan value.

requirements.statement: The system shall show per-track amount and breakdown bars with a shared legend and flag tracks with negative available as «تجاوز الموازنة».
acceptance_criteria: A track with available −10,000 shows the over-budget badge.
A plan without tracks shows «لا توجد مسارات في الخطة.».

requirements.statement: The system shall list initiatives (projects with source = initiative) linked to the plan with title, progress and budget.
acceptance_criteria: Only source = initiative projects appear.
Section is hidden when there are none.

requirements.statement: The system shall show the five most recent adjustments of the plan with type, reference, amount and date.
acceptance_criteria: At most five rows, newest first.
No adjustments shows «لا توجد تعديلات مالية بعد.».

requirements.statement: The system shall render the plan hierarchy as collapsible tracks with nested levels, each showing code-name, amount, compact breakdown and budget warning.
acceptance_criteria: Tracks are expanded by default and can be collapsed.
Empty plan shows «لا توجد مستويات بعد.».

requirements.statement: The system shall show counts of projects and applications per level (including descendants) and open a list dialog with key columns and links.
acceptance_criteria: Buttons are disabled when count is 0.
Project refs link to /projects/$id; application refs link to /reviewer/$id.

requirements.statement: The system shall show endowment share chips on levels that have their own split when the organization has two or more active endowments, linking to the endowment page.
acceptance_criteria: Inherited splits show no chips.
With one endowment no chips are shown.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a view switcher (summary, hierarchy, tree) and an edit entry button on plan pages, hiding the edit button while editing.
acceptance_criteria: The active view button is highlighted.
«تعديل الخطة» opens /plans/$id?edit=1.

requirements.statement: The system shall render a read-only zoomable tree of the plan with each node showing code-name, share of parent and amount, and a budget warning where children sums mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Root node shows plan name, 100 % and budget.
Nodes cannot be dragged or connected.

requirements.statement: The system shall open the adjustment dialog for a given plan and type from the plans register menu or the financial operations page, resetting all fields on open.
acceptance_criteria: Dialog title shows type and plan name.
Re-opening shows empty fields.

requirements.statement: The system shall let the user pick the source and/or target level among all plan levels (indented) and show the chosen level's amount and actual available.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a level shows «المبلغ … · المتاح الفعلي …».
Increase shows only one level picker.

requirements.statement: The system shall validate amount > 0, required levels, distinct source/target for transfers, and amount ≤ source actual available for decreases and transfers.
acceptance_criteria: Amount exceeding available shows «القيمة تتجاوز المتاح الفعلي للمستوى (…)».
Same source and target shows «لا يمكن النقل إلى نفس المستوى».

requirements.statement: The system shall require an evidence document (allowed formats, ≤ 10 MB), run an advisory AI check on it, and store it privately before applying the adjustment.
acceptance_criteria: «تنفيذ» is disabled without a file.
A .zip file is rejected with the format message.

requirements.statement: The system shall apply an increase by adding the amount to the target level, each of its ancestors and the plan budget.
acceptance_criteria: Worked example C: increase 2.1 by 100,000 → 2.1, Track 2 and plan each +100,000.
Sibling levels are unchanged.

requirements.statement: The system shall apply a decrease by subtracting the amount from the source level, each of its ancestors and the plan budget.
acceptance_criteria: Decrease 1.2 by 50,000 → 1.2, Track 1 and plan each −50,000.
Decrease above available is rejected before any write.

requirements.statement: The system shall apply a transfer by subtracting the amount along the source chain, re-reading levels and adding it along the target chain, leaving the plan budget unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer 1.1→2.1 of 100,000: Track 1 −100,000, Track 2 +100,000, plan unchanged.
Transfer between siblings leaves the common parent unchanged.

requirements.statement: The system shall record each executed adjustment (type, levels, amount, note, actor, evidence) with an ADJ reference and refresh plan, project and application data; on failure it shall delete the uploaded evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Success toast «تم تنفيذ {type}» and the register shows the new row.
On insert failure the evidence file no longer exists in storage.

requirements.statement: The system shall list adjustments in three tabs (increases, decreases, transfers) filterable by plan.
acceptance_criteria: Switching tab shows only that type.
Selecting a plan shows only its adjustments.

requirements.statement: The system shall show reference, plan, level(s) (source ← target for transfers), amount (red for decreases), creator, note, evidence link and date for each adjustment.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer rows show «source ← target».
Evidence opens via a 300-second signed URL.

requirements.statement: The system shall export the adjustments of the current tab (file adjustments-<type>), excluding the evidence column.
acceptance_criteria: Export file name includes the type.
Evidence column is not exported.

requirements.statement: The system shall record an endowment funding with amount, funding date, optional note, evidence document and acting persona.
acceptance_criteria: Missing evidence shows «أرفق المستند النظامي».
Successful save shows «تم تسجيل التغذية» and updates the endowment size.

requirements.statement: The system shall display the endowment's current size (sum of fundings) and its funding ledger (date, amount, note, document name).
acceptance_criteria: Size equals Σ funding amounts.
With no fundings the empty-state hint is shown and size shows «—».

requirements.statement: The system shall let the user toggle an endowment's participation in each level of each plan of its organization, rewriting that level's split equally among participants.
acceptance_criteria: Turning A off where A, B, C participate leaves B 50 % / C 50 %.
Turning off the last participant shows «يجب أن يشارك وقف واحد على الأقل في كل مستوى».

requirements.statement: The system shall resolve each level's effective endowment split as own rows, else nearest ancestor's rows, else equal default, with a single-endowment organization always 100 %.
acceptance_criteria: A level without own rows under a parent with A 70 / B 30 inherits 70/30.
With no rows anywhere and 2 endowments, 50/50 applies.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide equal and size-weighted split calculations totalling exactly 100 %.
acceptance_criteria: Equal split of 3 = 34/33/33.
Size-weighted is unavailable if any endowment has no funding.

requirements.statement: The system shall show an endowment's total allocation, used and available across its organization's plans.
acceptance_criteria: Available is green when ≥ 0, red otherwise.
Allocation follows the residual rule BR-PLN-30.

requirements.statement: The system shall show, per plan, the levels where the endowment has a share with level amount, percentage, share amount and an «(موروث)» marker for inherited percentages.
acceptance_criteria: Levels with 0 % are omitted.
Inherited rows are greyed and marked «(موروث)».

requirements.statement: The system shall list projects funded by the endowment with budget, percentage, endowment share and status.
acceptance_criteria: Share = project piece budget × %.
Project reference links to the project page.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a plan-item picker that links an application, project or grant program (default item) to a non-root level of an active, unlocked plan, or unlinks it.
acceptance_criteria: Options are labelled «year · code - name».
Choosing «غير مرتبط ببند» clears the link.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide an initiative selector listing non-root levels of active, unlocked plans for applicants on open opportunities and staff re-placing applications.
acceptance_criteria: Levels of locked plans are not listed.
Root tracks are not selectable.

requirements.statement: The system shall refuse to create projects from an approved application when the target plan item belongs to a locked plan.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer to a locked plan item fails with «ميزانية «…» مقفلة — لا يمكن اعتماد مشاريع جديدة منها».
Transfer to an unlocked plan item proceeds.

requirements.statement: The system shall redirect /initiatives to /projects filtered by source = initiative, replacing the history entry.
acceptance_criteria: Opening /initiatives shows the projects list filtered to initiatives.
Back navigation does not return to /initiatives.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute initiative/project progress as the weight-averaged progress of its activities, falling back to the stored progress.
acceptance_criteria: Activities (weight 1, 60 %) and (weight 3, 20 %) give 30 %.
No activities → stored progress rounded.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to browse and filter annual plans so that I can find a plan and see its execution status quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given plans of several years, When I select year 2026, Then only 2026 plans are listed.
Given I click a plan row, When the page loads, Then the plan summary of that plan is shown.
Given I saved a view with «معتمد», When I return to the page, Then the approval filter is still «معتمد».

stories.story: As a CEO I want portfolio KPIs for approved plans so that I can judge overall spend and indicator achievement.
acceptance_criteria: Given two approved plans of 10 M (paid 2 M) and 30 M (paid 3 M), When I open the register, Then spend shows 12.5 %.
Given an unapproved plan with payments, When KPIs compute, Then it is excluded from spend and indicator KPIs.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to create a new annual plan so that I can start allocating next year's budget.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid name, year and budget, When I save, Then a plan with a PLN-… reference appears in the list.
Given an empty name, When I save, Then the error «الاسم والسنة مطلوبان» is shown and nothing is saved.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want to lock a plan's budget with a documented decision so that no new projects are approved from a closed year.
acceptance_criteria: Given only one obligation choice is made, When I look at the confirm button, Then it is disabled.
Given both choices and a file, When I confirm, Then the plan is locked and its items no longer appear in plan-item pickers.
Given a lock decision, When it is saved, Then the document and choices are retrievable in the plan history (Recommended).

stories.story: As a finance officer I want to reopen a locked plan so that approvals can resume when a decision is reversed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a locked plan, When I confirm reopening, Then budget_locked is false and «أُعيد فتح الخطة» is shown.
Given the plan is reopened, When a staff member opens a plan-item picker, Then the plan's items are listed again (if the plan is active).

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to add tracks and sub-levels in an edit session so that I can build the plan structure before committing it.
acceptance_criteria: Given track 1 has children 1.1 and 1.2, When I add a child to track 1, Then the draft level gets code 1.3.
Given I added a draft level, When I look at the banner, Then it shows «1 تعديل غير محفوظ».

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to change level names and amounts in the session so that allocations reflect the revised plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a parent of 1,000,000 with children 600,000 and 400,000, When I draft child 1.2 to 300,000, Then the parent shows a warning with difference 100,000.
Given I edit a level and then restore its original values, When I check the change count, Then the change is no longer listed.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to edit the plan header, including approval and active flags, in the session so that plan status changes are evidenced.
acceptance_criteria: Given I toggle «معتمدة» on, When I apply, Then «تعديل بيانات الخطة» appears in the save list.
Given I saved the session, When I view history, Then a «تعديل الخطة» row holds before/after values.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to save all session changes at once with one official document so that the plan stays auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a level edit is pending and no file chosen, When I look at «حفظ الكل», Then it is disabled.
Given two level edits and a valid PDF, When I save, Then two history rows share the same evidence path and the session closes.
Given a save fails mid-way, When I retry, Then no partial changes remain (Recommended, FR-PLN-022).

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to cancel an edit session so that unwanted draft changes are discarded.
acceptance_criteria: Given three draft changes, When I click «إلغاء», Then the plan is shown in view mode with no changes saved.
Given I cancel, When I re-enter edit mode, Then the change count is 0.

stories.story: As an auditor I want to see the evidenced history of plan edits so that I can verify each change against its official document.
acceptance_criteria: Given a level edit was saved, When I open the summary, Then a «تعديل مستوى» row with its date and document is listed.
Given I click the document, When the URL is signed, Then it opens in a new tab.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to define indicators on leaf plan items so that funded work has measurable targets.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quantitative indicator without unit, When I add it, Then «أدخل المؤشر والوحدة والعدد» is shown.
Given an indicator linked to a project, When I try to delete it, Then the dialog explains the links and nothing is deleted.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want each plan level to show paid, due, committed, available and pending amounts so that I know how much can still be committed.
acceptance_criteria: Given worked example A, When I open the level, Then it shows paid 100,000, due 50,000, approved 600,000 and available 250,000.
Given an application under review on the level, When figures compute, Then available is not reduced by it.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want a project funded by several initiatives to be split across them so that plan usage is counted once and in the right items.
acceptance_criteria: Given project P3 300,000 with allocations 200,000 / 100,000 and 90,000 paid, When I view L1, Then paid shows 60,000 and approved 140,000.
Given the same project, When I view the plan total, Then its budget is counted once (300,000).

stories.story: As a CEO I want a one-page plan summary so that I can assess budget use, spend rates, tracks at risk and recent changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a track with available below zero, When I open the summary, Then it shows «تجاوز الموازنة».
Given seven adjustments, When I open the summary, Then only the five most recent are listed.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to navigate the plan hierarchy with each level's figures so that I can see where money is allocated and consumed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a plan with tracks, When I open the hierarchy, Then tracks are expanded with amount and breakdown.
Given the organization has two active endowments and a level with its own split, When I view it, Then share chips link to the endowment pages.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to list the projects and applications charged to a level so that I can verify what consumes its budget.
acceptance_criteria: Given a track whose child has 3 projects, When I click the track's projects button, Then the dialog lists the 3 projects.
Given I click an application reference, When navigation completes, Then the reviewer detail opens.

stories.story: As a CEO I want a tree diagram of the plan so that I can present the structure and proportions visually.
acceptance_criteria: Given a track of 2 M in a 10 M plan, When I open the tree, Then the node shows 20 %.
Given the diagram, When I try to drag a node, Then it does not move.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want to increase a level's budget with an official document so that additional funding is reflected throughout the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given level 2.1 of 500,000 under track 2 of 500,000 in a 1.5 M plan, When I increase 2.1 by 100,000, Then 2.1, track 2 and plan become 600,000, 600,000 and 1.6 M.
Given the increase succeeded, When I open the operations register, Then an ADJ row with my evidence is listed.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want to decrease a level's budget within its actual availability so that cuts never undercut existing commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a level with available 250,000, When I decrease by 300,000, Then the operation is rejected and nothing changes.
Given a valid decrease of 50,000, When executed, Then the level, its ancestors and the plan budget each drop by 50,000.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want to transfer allocations between levels so that budget follows changing priorities without changing the plan total.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1.1 (600,000) and 2.1 (500,000), When I transfer 100,000 from 1.1 to 2.1, Then track 1 decreases and track 2 increases by 100,000 and the plan budget is unchanged.
Given source equals target, When I execute, Then the error «لا يمكن النقل إلى نفس المستوى» is shown.

stories.story: As a finance officer I want a register of all budget operations so that I can review and evidence every movement.
acceptance_criteria: Given the transfers tab, When rows load, Then each shows «source ← target».
Given a plan filter, When applied, Then only that plan's adjustments are listed.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to record endowment fundings with documents so that each endowment's size is known and evidenced.
acceptance_criteria: Given an endowment with fundings 1 M and 0.5 M, When I open it, Then «حجم الوقف الحالي» shows 1.5 M.
Given no evidence, When I try to save, Then the save button is disabled.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to set which endowments fund each plan level so that plan money is attributed to the right source.
acceptance_criteria: Given A, B, C share a level equally, When I switch A off, Then B and C show 50 % each.
Given only A participates in a level, When I switch A off, Then the error is shown and nothing changes.

stories.story: As a grants manager I want an endowment's share of plans and projects so that I can report what each endowment finances.
acceptance_criteria: Given worked example D, When I open endowment A, Then its allocation for track 1 is 500,000.
Given a level inherits A's percentage, When listed, Then it is marked «(موروث)».

stories.story: As a grants manager I want to link applications, projects and programs to plan items so that every commitment is charged to the plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a locked plan, When I open the picker, Then its items are not offered.
Given an approved application linked to a locked plan item, When it is transferred to a project, Then the transfer is refused with the lock message.

stories.story: As an applicant I want to choose the initiative my request serves on an open opportunity so that it is routed to the right plan item.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active unlocked plan with sub-levels, When I open the initiative list, Then only its non-root levels are listed.
Given a locked plan, When I open the list, Then none of its levels appear.

stories.story: As a project manager I want initiatives to be managed as projects with activity-based progress so that their plan usage and progress are consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Given I open /initiatives, When the route loads, Then I land on /projects?source=initiative.
Given activities weighted 1 at 60 % and 3 at 20 %, When progress is computed, Then it shows 30 %.

rules.rule: Level «used» = Σ budget of projects linked to the level or any descendant + Σ requested_amount of applications linked to the level or any descendant whose status is `approved` and `transferred = false`.
Level «actual available» (المتاح الفعلي) = level.amount − used. This is the figure shown in the adjustment dialog and used to validate decreases/transfers. Child allocations are not deducted.

Five-way breakdown per level/plan: paid = Σ payments in `awaiting_receipt`/`paid`; due = Σ payments in `due`/`awaiting_approval`/`awaiting_transfer`; approved = Σ max(0, project budget − (paid+due)×share) + Σ approved-not-transferred application amounts; available = total − approved − due − paid. Payments in `new` stay inside approved; `cancelled` payments are ignored.
«Pending» (محجوز مؤقتاً) = Σ requested_amount of applications in `submitted`/`under_review`; it is informational only and never reduces available or the ceiling.
Plan-level breakdown uses plan.budget as total and includes every project/application linked to any level of the plan (not the sum of root-level breakdowns).

A project with two or more project_plan_allocations rows is counted as one piece per allocation: piece budget = allocation amount, share = amount ÷ Σ allocation amounts (fallback divisor 1); its payments are prorated by share. With fewer than two rows the project counts fully at projects.plan_level_id (share 1).
Spend from budget (الصرف من الموازنة) = min(100, plan paid ÷ plan.budget × 100); 0 when budget is 0.
Spend of approved (الصرف من المعتمد) = min(100, paid ÷ (approved + due + paid) × 100); 0 when the base is 0.
Plans-list portfolio KPIs consider approved plans only: spend = Σ (spend% × budget) ÷ Σ budget; indicator achievement = Σ(indicators_progress × budget) ÷ Σ budget. «عدد الخطط» counts all plans.
Project/initiative progress = round(Σ activity weight × progress ÷ Σ weight) when activities with non-zero total weight exist; otherwise round(stored projects.progress).
An adjustment amount must be strictly greater than zero.
Every adjustment requires an evidence document with extension pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, png, jpg or jpeg and size ≤ 10 MB, stored privately at `plan-adjustments/<plan_id>/<uuid>/<file name>`.
Increase: a target level is required; the target and every ancestor are increased by the amount and plan.budget is increased by the amount.
Decrease: a source level is required and amount ≤ source actual available (BR-PLN-02); the source and every ancestor are reduced by the amount and plan.budget is reduced by the amount.

Transfer: source and target are required and must differ; amount ≤ source actual available; source chain −amount, then levels are re-read and target chain +amount; plan.budget unchanged; common ancestors net to zero.
Each executed adjustment is recorded with plan, type, source (null for increase), target (null for decrease), amount, note, acting persona and evidence; reference ADJ-… is assigned by DB trigger.
If any step fails after the evidence upload, the evidence file is deleted; level/plan amounts already written are not reverted.

Plan structure edits: one evidence document (same format/size rule as BR-PLN-12) per edit session, required when any existing item (plan header, level, endowment split) changes; sessions containing only additions need no evidence. Stored at `plan-edits/<plan_id>/<uuid>/<file name>`.

On commit, each changed existing item writes one plan_edit_history row (before/after JSON, shared evidence); added levels write no history row. plan_edit_history is append-only (insert/select policies only).
New level code = `<parent code>.<n>` (root: `<n>`) where n = max(sort_order of siblings, including draft siblings) + 1; sort_order = n.

Draft coalescing: at most one pending change per existing level; a change whose values equal the original is dropped; editing a draft (added) level updates its add record; only the latest plan-header change is kept.

When a level (or the plan) has children and Σ children amounts ≠ parent amount (difference rounded to 2 decimals), a non-blocking warning shows the children sum and the absolute difference. Saving is not blocked.
Plan header: name (trimmed) and year required; budget must be a finite number ≥ 0; year chosen from 2021–2031; new plan defaults: year = current year + 1, active = true, approved = false.
Level: name (trimmed) required; amount required, finite and ≥ 0.
When endowment shares are specified for a level they must total exactly 100 % (rounded to 2 decimals).

Effective endowment split of a level: if the organization has exactly one active endowment → that endowment 100 %; else the level's own rows; else the nearest ancestor's rows (inherited); else an equal split among all active endowments.
Equal split: each endowment gets floor(100 ÷ n); the first gets the remainder so the total is exactly 100 (e.g. 34/33/33).
Size-weighted split: shares proportional to current endowment sizes, rounded to integers; rounding difference added to the largest endowment; not available when any selected endowment has size ≤ 0.

Participation toggle: start from the level's effective participants, add or remove the endowment, and rewrite the level's own rows as an equal split; at least one endowment must participate in every level.

Endowment allocation within a plan = Σ over levels of max(0, level.amount − Σ children amounts) × endowment % at that level (each level contributes only its unallocated residual; leaves contribute their full amount).
Endowment used = Σ (project piece budget × endowment % at the project's level) + Σ (approved-not-transferred application amount × %); endowment available = allocation − used.
Endowment size = Σ of its funding movements (endowment_fundings.amount); it grows as the endowment is topped up during the year.
Recording a funding requires amount > 0, a funding date (default today), and a valid evidence document; note optional. If the insert fails the uploaded file is removed.
Endowment split UI (chips, participation card) is shown only when the organization has two or more active endowments.

A locked plan (budget_locked) accepts no new project approvals: pickers exclude locked or inactive plans (an existing link stays visible) and transferApplication refuses levels of a locked plan; running projects continue.

Locking requires choosing how contracted-not-due and due-not-paid obligations are treated (continue on this plan / carry to next plan) and attaching an evidence file; reopening requires confirmation only.
Plan-item pickers list only non-root levels (levels with a parent) of active, unlocked plans, labelled `<year> · <code> - <name>`.
Initiatives are projects with projects.source = 'initiative'; the legacy /initiatives route redirects to /projects?source=initiative.
Plan structure and header changes (including the approval and active flags) are made only in the hierarchy edit session (?edit=1) and committed together.

Indicators attach to persisted leaf levels only; quantitative indicators need name, unit and target > 0; milestones get unit «تحقق» and target 1; an indicator linked to applications or projects cannot be deleted.
A root track whose breakdown available < 0 is flagged «تجاوز الموازنة» on the plan summary.
Plans receive reference numbers PLN-… from a DB trigger on insert.
Plans are listed newest year first; default hidden columns are plan number and creation date; default page size 15.
Tree view share of a level = level.amount ÷ parent amount × 100 (plan.budget for root levels; 0 when parent amount is 0).

issues.description: applyAdjustment is not atomic: shiftChain updates each level of the chain in separate requests, then plans.budget, then inserts budget_adjustments. A failure mid-way leaves amounts partly changed with no adjustment record; only the evidence file is removed.
issues.recommendation: Execute each adjustment as one database transaction (RPC / stored procedure) that validates availability server-side and writes amounts + record together.

issues.description: savePlanDraft is not atomic: inserts/updates/history rows run sequentially; on error, earlier writes persist, the uploaded evidence is not deleted, and the client draft is kept, so re-saving can duplicate added levels.
issues.recommendation: Commit the change set in one transaction; on failure roll back everything and delete the evidence; make adds idempotent.

issues.description: Plan lock dialog: the evidence file is only read for its name (never uploaded or stored); the two obligation-treatment choices are shown in a toast but not persisted; no audit row is written for lock or reopen; reopen requires no evidence.
issues.recommendation: Persist lock/reopen as an evidenced, audited operation (who, when, choices, document) and implement carry-over behaviour for ‘ترحَّل للخطة القادمة’.

issues.description: No role-based authorization: every plan action (create, edit, approve, adjust, lock, endowment funding/participation) is available to any persona; routes are reachable by URL; RLS grants any signed-in user full access.
issues.recommendation: Define a permission matrix (OQ-PLN-01) and enforce it in RLS / server functions, not only in navigation.

issues.description: Decrease and transfer validate only against amount − used of the source (BR-PLN-02) and ignore child allocations. Decreasing a parent does not touch its children, so children can exceed the parent (only a warning appears).
issues.recommendation: For non-leaf sources validate against the unallocated residual (amount − Σ children) or cascade the change to a chosen child.

issues.description: Transfers between a level and its own ancestor/descendant produce non-intuitive results: child→parent creates unallocated residual at the parent; parent→child leaves the parent unchanged and over-allocates children.
issues.recommendation: Block transfers between levels on the same branch, or define explicit ‘allocate residual to child’ semantics.

issues.description: Added levels are not audited: additions-only sessions need no evidence and savePlanDraft writes no plan_edit_history row for ‘add’ changes, although additions change the allocated structure.
issues.recommendation: Write a history row for every added level and decide whether additions to an approved plan need evidence (OQ-PLN-06).

issues.description: Levels cannot be deleted, moved to another parent, re-ordered or re-coded anywhere in the UI.
issues.recommendation: Confirm requirement (OQ-PLN-07); if needed, add evidenced delete/move with guards for linked projects, applications, indicators and adjustments.

issues.description: plans.indicators_progress is a stored number that no code ever updates; plan list, portfolio KPI and summary show a static (seeded) value unrelated to leaf indicators.
issues.recommendation: Derive plan indicator achievement from leaf indicator targets and accepted evidence (see PRJ), or confirm a manual entry process (OQ-PLN-08).

issues.description: usePlanData loads plans, levels, adjustments and endowments of all tenants without a tenant filter; the plans list, adjustments register and pickers therefore mix organizations, and new plans are inserted with the hard-coded TENANT_ID. Reports page does filter by tenant (inconsistent).
issues.recommendation: Scope every plan query and insert to the current persona's tenant and enforce tenant isolation in RLS.

issues.description: On the Financial Operations page, with filter ‘كل الخطط’ the «new adjustment» button silently targets the first active plan (or the first plan); the user cannot choose the plan in the dialog.
issues.recommendation: Add a plan selector inside the adjustment dialog or disable the button until a plan is selected.

issues.description: Adjustments are allowed on unapproved, inactive or locked plans; there is no state guard.
issues.recommendation: Confirm the allowed plan states for each adjustment type (OQ-PLN-12) and enforce them.

issues.description: Endowment page levels table shows level.amount × % for every level, while the allocation total counts only each level's unallocated residual (BR-PLN-30); row values therefore do not add up to «الحصة».
issues.recommendation: Show the residual-based share per row (or add a column) so the table reconciles with the total.

issues.description: Endowment participation toggles write plan_level_endowments immediately with no evidence document and no history row, contradicting the ‘every financial operation requires evidence’ principle and the edit-session approach used for other split changes.
issues.recommendation: Route participation changes through an evidenced, audited change (e.g., the plan edit session) — see OQ-PLN-09.

issues.description: Endowment funding evidence is listed by file name only and cannot be opened; fundings cannot be corrected or reversed.
issues.recommendation: Add signed-URL opening and an evidenced reversal entry (OQ-PLN-13).

issues.description: The per-level endowment split editor (SharesField) is compiled but disabled (`splitting = false`); split editing in the session is therefore unreachable while savePlanDraft still supports it — dead code.
issues.recommendation: Remove or re-enable deliberately once the split-editing owner (plan session vs endowment page) is decided.

issues.description: Non-session save paths (savePlanEdit; PlanEditor/LevelEditor without onApply for existing items) are not reachable from current UI — dead code with a different audit pattern.
issues.recommendation: Remove to keep a single commit path (savePlanDraft).

issues.description: Edit-session drafts live only in browser memory: they are lost on refresh or navigation without warning; a plan-header change is recorded even when values equal the original.
issues.recommendation: Add an unsaved-changes guard and drop no-op header changes; consider server-side drafts.

issues.description: In edit mode, leaf indicator add/delete is written immediately, outside the draft and without evidence; cancelling the session does not undo it.
issues.recommendation: Include indicator changes in the session change set or clearly separate them from the session UI.

issues.description: Schema drift: plans.budget_locked, endowment_fundings and project_plan_allocations appear in types.ts but in no SQL migration.
issues.recommendation: Add the missing migrations (with constraints) so environments can be rebuilt reproducibly.

issues.description: The «pending» bucket counts applications in `submitted`/`under_review`, but current application statuses are pending / approved / closed / cancelled / awaiting_apology (legacy enum values). The «محجوز مؤقتاً» figure is therefore always 0.
issues.recommendation: Redefine pending as applications with status `pending` (optionally from a given stage) linked to the level; confirm with stakeholders (OQ-PLN-11).

issues.description: Two definitions of ‘available’ coexist: idx.available = amount − used (used for adjustments) and breakdown.available = total − approved − due − paid. They diverge when payments exceed a project budget (approved is clamped at 0).
issues.recommendation: Use one definition everywhere and flag overpaid projects explicitly.

issues.description: Inactive endowments' existing own rows still count in ownShares/effectiveShares, so a deactivated endowment can keep a share, while equal-split defaults ignore it.
issues.recommendation: Filter own rows by active endowments and re-normalise, or block deactivation while shares exist.

issues.description: Adjustment and edit-session amounts are computed from the client snapshot (stale data); concurrent users can overwrite each other's changes (lost update).
issues.recommendation: Apply deltas server-side (amount = amount + delta) inside a transaction with row locks.

issues.description: Plan summary computes projectTotal / pendingTotal but never displays them (dead code).
issues.recommendation: Remove or surface the figures.

open_questions.question: Which roles may create plans, edit structure, approve plans, execute increases/decreases/transfers, lock/reopen plans and manage endowment funding/participation? Is segregation of duties (maker ≠ approver) required?
Is plan approval a formal multi-step workflow (e.g., board/CEO approval) rather than a flag? Should an unapproved plan be usable for linking applications, adjustments or project transfers?
What must happen to obligations marked ‘carry to next plan’ when a plan is locked (automatic carry-over adjustments, re-linking projects, reporting only)?
Should decreases/transfers on parent levels be limited to the unallocated residual, or cascade to children? Should transfers within the same branch be allowed?
May an organization have several plans for the same year, or several active plans at once?
Do level additions to an approved plan require an evidence document and audit history?
Must users be able to delete, move or re-order levels? What happens to linked projects, applications, indicators and adjustments?
How is plan indicator achievement (indicators_progress) calculated and by whom is it maintained?
Do endowment participation/split changes require an evidence document and approval like other financial operations? Where should splits be edited (plan session or endowment page)?
Should a mismatch between children sum and parent amount block saving or approving a plan?
Which application states should count as ‘pending / temporarily reserved’ against a level (all pending, or only from a certain review stage)?
Which adjustment types are allowed on unapproved, inactive or locked plans?
How are erroneous endowment fundings corrected (reversal entry, edit with evidence)?
Must budget adjustments go through an approval (maker-checker) step before being applied?
Should the AI evidence check (DocAiCheck) ever block an operation (e.g., verdict ‘غير مطابق’), or remain advisory?
What is the intended level taxonomy and maximum depth (track → item → initiative)? Are only non-root levels valid funding targets?
What is the business value and target audience of the endowment portion report (e.g., reporting to endowment boards)?
